tools.name: search
tools.description: Use this when you need a player_id or team_id, or the user names a player or team you have not resolved yet ('Jokic', 'Lamar Jackson', 'BOS'); it is accent- and typo-tolerant. Returns the matching NBA and NFL players and teams with their numeric ids and page urls. Not for stats: call player_profile

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search, rankings_and_ratings · Private data: head_to_head, team_profile, game_projection, props_research · Public sink: injury_consequences.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search, rankings_and_ratings · Private data: head_to_head, team_profile, game_projection, props_research · Public sink: injury_consequences

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
